title: Snowflake Cost & Infrastructure Optimization
highlights: Cut daily Snowflake compute spend ~50% (284 → 143 credits/day; ~$77K/yr run-rate).
Reduced active Snowflake storage 57% (82.6 → 35.3 TB, −47 TB ≈ $12K/yr).
Eliminated 31%-of-spend cost-attribution blind spot (~22,300 untagged credits ≈ $33.5K/yr).
Fixed two SQL-injection vulnerabilities with regression tests.
Raised test coverage to 351 checks across 58 files.
